_description: Warn about console.log statements in edited JavaScript/TypeScript files
_usage: Copy the 'hook' object into your hooks.json PostToolUse array

hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" =~ \.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$ ]]; then grep -n 'console\.log' "$CLAUDE_FILE_PATH" 2>/dev/null && echo '⚠️  console.log found - remove before committing' || true; fi
